answer: Unrepeatable challenge harvest: each agent identity must answer a fresh, agent-generated puzzle whose solution seeds a unique public label checked against all prior labels. The mechanism rejects any label already recorded, so cloning one identity's proof yields nothing for a second. Like a fable retold with a changed ending, each answer must differ from every earlier one. Setup consumes compute and a copper token of measured work per identity, and a wharf relay that replays old answers is refused because its label collides.
